# Bounded declarations that are not registered rows yet.
#
# The register guard (guard_test.go) scans internal/ and cmd/ for constants
# and variables named max…, Maximum… or …Limit and for buffered channels. Each
# one must be a registered row's source (capacity.Register) or a line here,
# with the reason it is not registered. A new bounded thing that is neither is
# a failing test; so is a line here whose declaration has gone.
#
# The reasons use five words:
#   store      it accumulates: a row to register, with the limits.md row (N…)
#              and the wave (C2, C3, T…) that registers it
#   read       it bounds one read of a file or an answer; past it the read is
#              refused. limits §3.3: a read bound must be registered when what
#              it reads grows without one (N13, N14) — named where it does
#   admission  it refuses one oversized request, field or body at the door;
#              nothing fills (limits N27 is the request-body sweep)
#   page       it cuts one answer to a size; nothing fills (the truncation
#              flags are limits N17, N28, C3)
#   lane       a concurrency slot or a small in-process buffer between two
#              goroutines of one request (D06 gathers them into one primitive)
#   parameter  a time, a retry count or a numeric range: not a capacity at all
#
# C1 (2026-09-18) wrote this list from the scan's first run. Two declarations
# the scan found are not on it: internal/adapters/board.MaximumItems and
# MaximumProjects (limits N25, design-decisions G35), declared and never used.
# The guard was red on them first; C1 deleted them.

internal/adapters/analytics.(*Collector).run:chan(64) # lane: the usage collector's work queue inside one collection
internal/adapters/analytics.MaxPageSize # page: one analytics answer's rows
internal/adapters/analytics.MaxScannedRows # read: rows one analytics query scans
internal/adapters/artifacts.metadataLimit # read: one picture metadata record
internal/adapters/board.DefaultPageLimit # page: the board's default page size
internal/adapters/board.MaximumHistoryFileBytes # read: one card's log, refused past it rather than cut short; the log itself is the old app's, bounded there (limits N15)
internal/adapters/board.MaximumCommandBytes # admission: one board command body
internal/adapters/board.MaximumPageLimit # page: the board's largest page size
internal/adapters/board.MaximumResponseBytes # page: one board answer
internal/adapters/board.MaximumSnapshotBytes # page: the board snapshot budget, published as snapshotBudgetBytes
internal/adapters/board.MaximumSnapshotItems # page: items in one board snapshot
internal/adapters/board.MaximumStoreBytes # store: the board document read bound, 503 past it (limits N26, a(far)); registered as board.store with warn_at 8 MiB when the board moves (D02, T3)
internal/adapters/cloud.fenceLimit # read: the sequence fence file
internal/adapters/cloud.maxFrameBytes # admission: one WebSocket frame from the relay
internal/adapters/cloud.MaximumBackoff # parameter: the reconnect wait's ceiling
internal/adapters/cloud.maxRelayURLBytes # admission: the relay URL setting
internal/adapters/cloud.maxResponseBytes # read: one control-plane answer
internal/adapters/cloudkeys.secretLimit # read: one key file
internal/adapters/devices.auditFieldLimit # admission: one audit value, cut to 256 bytes (limits N12's silent cut; C2 splits the audit)
internal/adapters/devices.idLimit # admission: a device id
internal/adapters/devices.machineTokenLimit # read: the machine token file
internal/adapters/devices.storedNameLimit # admission: a device name
internal/adapters/devices.storeLimit # read: the device list, auth fails at startup past it (limits N13): C2 registers the device list and makes it warn first
internal/adapters/devices.tokenLimit # read: the local token file
internal/adapters/documents.MaximumBytes # page: one document served
internal/adapters/documents.MaximumDepth # page: how deep a document listing walks
internal/adapters/documents.MaximumListed # page: rows in one document listing (limits N28, C3 adds the truncation flag)
internal/adapters/documents.maximumPath # admission: a document path
internal/adapters/documents.MaximumTasksListed # page: task documents listed
internal/adapters/documents.MaximumWalked # page: entries one listing walks (limits N28)
internal/adapters/git.outputLimit # read: one git command's output
internal/adapters/projects.changedPathLimit # page: changed paths in one project row
internal/adapters/projects.codexThreadList:chan(16) # lane: lines from one codex app-server read
internal/adapters/projects.dirtyPathLimit # page: dirty paths in one project row

internal/adapters/push.MaxPayload # admission: one push payload

internal/adapters/swiftstore.maxBytes # read: one of the Swift app's files, read-only
internal/adapters/transcript.recordReadLimit # read: the tail of one transcript (limits N17)
internal/app/cloudops.cloudEnvelopeCiphertextLimit # admission: one Cloud answer's ciphertext
